recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-6097 unless a future package-generation check shows ConceptMap resources have disappeared from the current core package.
issue_request: FHIR-6097 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking that ConceptMap resources be distributed in validation.zip so reference implementations could obtain all core definitions from one metadata archive rather than combining validation.zip and valuesets.zip.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 5978. The corresponding git-svn commit 7e1c01dd6f36d8496dad6fa58c7e677cd65cb096 is titled "#6097 - add concept maps to validation.zip" and changed the old publisher to add conceptmaps.xml and conceptmaps.json to validation.zip.
additional_context: The historical validation.zip artifact is no longer the current distribution mechanism. Current downloads describe hl7.fhir.r6.core as the package containing all resources needed to test conformance to the FHIR specification and/or generate code, and note that validators and other FHIR tools use the NPM package distribution. ConceptMap is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current build package surface at build.fhir.org contains ConceptMap resources, ConceptMap StructureDefinition/SearchParameters/OperationDefinition, and ConceptMap terminology artifacts. FHIR-8623 is a naturally related validation.zip ConceptMap URL correction, but it is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the historical publisher fix satisfied the original validation.zip request and the current core package model preserves ConceptMap inclusion for validation/code-generation metadata.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive correction for the validation.zip ConceptMap aggregate; already audited on the combined branch by 3b017e24c8851d6076c836b922da19b0b64db6f9, so no duplicate commit was published.
